criteria.name: schema_conformance
criteria.description: Does the extracted output match the requested field names and types exactly, with no missing required fields or invented extra ones?

criteria.name: value_accuracy
criteria.description: Does every extracted value match what the source text actually says, character-for-character where the source is exact (dates, IDs, amounts)?

criteria.name: null_handling
criteria.description: When a field genuinely isn't present in the source, is it left null or omitted rather than filled with a guessed or hallucinated value?
